visible_observation: The main title 'BELOW THE LAST LIGHT' is rendered in a low-contrast, semi-transparent white that blends into the background gradient. The central vertical graphic element (the bioluminescent organism) is positioned directly behind the text, creating a visual collision where the text and image compete for dominance without either winning. The layout relies on a standard centered alignment that feels static rather than atmospheric.
critique: The composition lacks a definitive focal point due to the 'muddy' contrast between the text and the background. The central graphic is visually buried by the title, destroying the sense of depth and scale required for a deep-sea theme. The layout feels like a flat overlay rather than a unified spatial environment.
revision: Shift the main title to the upper-left quadrant to break the static center alignment. Increase the opacity and weight of the title text to ensure it reads as a solid anchor. Move the central vertical graphic element to the right side of the canvas, allowing it to occupy the negative space and create a diagonal visual tension with the text.
protected_strength: The subtle, ghostly aesthetic of the bioluminescent outlines and the atmospheric gradient background must be preserved to maintain the sense of mystery.
